name: 3D Texture Volume Render
definition: A node that renders volumetric textures from 3D data to create cloud and fog effects. It renders the volume of a shape described by a 3D texture using its corresponding signed distance field.
summary: The 3D Texture Volume Render node creates cloud effects by integrating light through a compressed 16x16 grid of 256 slices, differing from standard ray marching by using specific texture layouts and built-in lighting models.
